english.q: Which ocean is the largest?
english.text:
The largest ocean in the world is the **Pacific Ocean**.

It covers an area of approximately 165.25 million square kilometers (63.8 million square miles), which is more than twice the size of the next largest ocean, the Atlantic Ocean. The Pacific Ocean is also the deepest, containing the Mariana Trench, and it stretches from the Arctic Circle in the north to the Antarctic Circle in the south, encompassing the entire western hemisphere and extending into the eastern hemisphere.

english.q: What is the capital of Italy?
english.text:
The capital of Italy is **Rome**.

Located in the central-western part of the country, Rome has served as the capital since 734 AD and remains the nation's political, cultural, and economic center. It is also one of the most famous cities in the world, renowned for its rich history, ancient ruins, and significant role in the Catholic Church as the seat of the Pope.
